title: 🎬 Documentary: Real Venda Style of Living in Venda Village
summary: The documentary "Real Venda Style of Living in Venda Village" offers an immersive look into the authentic daily life of a traditional South African Xhosa community. Available on Zland DigiMarket, it captures the lives of young Venda women living communally in a rondavel, engaging in activities like cooking, braiding hair, and gathering vegetables by hand. The film features no actors or staged scenes, presenting the genuine rhythm of rural life with traditional dances, chants, and lively conversations. The women wear traditional Vendas clothing, and the documentary emphasizes cultural integrity, showing tradition with dignity rather than as entertainment. It serves as a visual anthropology tool, demonstrating intergenerational learning and survival skills, and is used in heritage programs and African studies. Filmed in March 2025 in a real Vendas village in the Eastern Cape, South Africa, the documentary features real villagers, guided by Xhosa community elders for accuracy. It includes cultural nudity, with viewer discretion advised for those under 18. The audio is entirely original, captured on location. The documentary is available for secure digital download or private streaming, with subtitles in English and French. Supporting this documentary helps preserve endangered African traditions, empower local storytellers, and fund future fieldwork by ZuluLand Official TV. Produced by ZuluLand Official TV, it is intended for academic use or licensing, with unauthorized copying prohibited.

Météo-France prévoit des températures de 34 à 38 °C, atteignant ponctuellement 40 °C près de la Méditerranée. Ces fortes chaleurs dureront au moins jusqu’à mardi, avec des nuits où la température ne descendra pas en dessous de 20 degrés. Un "dôme de chaleur", un puissant anticyclone, piège l’air chaud et augmente les risques d’incendies. En Grèce, l’île de Chios a été ravagée par les flammes, et des villages à l’est d’Athènes ont été évacués. En France, les autorités locales, pompiers et préfectures multiplient les alertes et rappels de précaution. Le numéro vert canicule a été réactivé pour informer le public et protéger les plus vulnérables.
